chapter: Louisville, Buck and the carnival years
title: Leaving Detroit and the usher job in Louisville
summary: After a cheating gambler, he leaves Detroit, joins family, and goes home to Louisville to usher in a theatre gallery.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: When I get the contract and everything for the cabaret, I put the carnival down. I get the letter from my partner to come home. I'm with the carnival and I put it down and go to Detroit. While I'm in Detroit -- a guy was cheating in a game so I want to leave the cabaret now. Instead of not playing I just as soon leave the cabaret. Get what I'm saying or do you? Not that I could quit gambling and be sufficient, but to leave the cabaret, I'd be better off. That's my point.

So I go join my mother and my older sister who was with another show which is -- what was the name of that show? I forgot the name of that show they were with. Anyway, I went to join them and then I figured I'd go from here, I'd go back to Louisville because Buck wanted me to come back. So I go back to Louisville and the job he had was ushering in the gallery in the B.F. Kay-May Anderson Theatre in Louisville, Kentucky which was quite surprising. I would have never went back for no job like that. But to please him I took the job.
